description: Africa - Solar Global Horizontal Irradiance is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Renewable energy, Resource assessments", published or maintained by Dimitris Mentis (KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm). Global Horizontal Irradiance on Africa in kWh/m2/year provided by IRENA's Global Atlas. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa. It has 1 file in TIFF. The portal files it under Renewable energy, Resource assessments, Solar. The portal gives 2016 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
